I'd go as far as to say this might be the greatest roguelite ever made. Just when I think I'm tired of this game it pulls me right back in, and I have yet to play a shooter that captures the fluidity of the movement/gunplay of this game. It almost has ruined other FPS games for me, because I just wish it felt like Roboquest.

really fun fast paced game. that said, it might be badly optimized on some lower end systems despite the game itself looking like it shouldn't. 

that said, i have no issues on my system personally. just that some people i recommended this to weren't able to play it above 10FPS, where they could easily play other more high res games with no complaint.

additionally, i think some of the guns just feel objectively weak and hard to make work. i love to specialize on something when playing a game, but i feel like some of the guns just either specialize too much with too little payoff for it, or are just a jack of all trades without any drawbacks. but im being partially hyperbolic here since this isn't something a specific gun has, but moreso just the general gun design.

i like how they also embrace tech like rocket jumping, and if you think theres synergy there probably is.
